study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multimodal normative modeling in Alzheimer's Disease with introspective variational autoencoders

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Multimodal soft-introspective VAE (mmSIVAE) with MOPOE aggregation for normative modeling.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: First, we introduce a novel multimodal softintrospective VAE (mmSIVAE) for normative modeling across multiple neuroimaging modalities.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical and subcortical brain volumes from T1-weighted MRI plus amyloid FBP and tau FTP PET SUVRs.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Cortical and subcortical brain volumes extracted from T1-weighted MRI, amyloid FBP and tau FTP scans (FreeSurfer) were used as input to three modality specific encoders.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Conditioned on age and sex (one-hot encoded).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We conditioned our proposed mmVAE on the age and sex of patients, to ensure that the deviations in regional brain volumes reflect only disease pathology and not deviations due to effects of covariates.
